sections.heading: VSC modeling in dq frame
sections.text: Voltage-sourced converters are most naturally modeled and controlled in the synchronous dq reference frame, which transforms AC quantities to DC for PI control. The dq decoupling terms (omega*L cross-coupling) are essential for independent axis control.

sections.heading: Multilevel converter topologies
sections.text: NPC and T-type three-level converters reduce THD and switch voltage stress compared to two-level. NPC is preferred above 600V DC bus; T-type is more efficient below 600V due to lower conduction loss in the neutral-point switches.
